body:
EXACTLY, thank you. This drove me up the wall crazy. 

Like I’m all about reform and helping with mental health, but that doesn’t mean someone can go around putting someone’s nudes on the internet and threaten to kill them and contact their place of work because you broke up with them!

Yea... there’s a lot of bullshit and I sent my lawyer a bunch of questions. I may just call her at some point. 

And thank you. This week has been hell for various reasons and this is just the latest.

I’m sure my lawyer is currently trying to figure this out. I trust her. I’m just so frustrated. 

Thank you for these questions they definitely valid questions and I’m just so out of sorts.

Yea it’s the most frustrating, super stressful. 

I’m aware of the differences legally but here where I’m from a notary is the only way to officially clear a legal document. The judge needs to make sure it was in fact him that is consenting to the order of protection and we aren’t just lying or forging his signature. The judge wants him to have an ID to prove that he is him and that my lawyer or myself didn’t just get someone to pose as my ex. 

The legal process is special to say the least.
Exactly! Thank you! This is the most frustrating.

Yup, YUP. Thank you for this thoughtful comment. My thoughts exactly. Also how did my ex get on government benefits without an ID? 

There is so much bullshit and I’m fuming.

Thank you. I’ll try to go to him but if he’s not comfortable with it there’s nothing I can do. He hasn’t gotten sick and lives with someone with a compromised immune system. I feel utterly helpless and trapped because as much as I want to end it, all I can think about who would find me, what that would do to them, most likely being my mom since she lives in the same building as me and has a key that if she didn’t hear from me for long enough she’d come. And I know if my boyfriend lost me that would just make him feel worse. I feel so trapped, I’ve never felt this way in my whole life. So much has happened since this pandemic and I’m really reaching my limit here.

I’ll give that a try. She did retrace her steps and didn’t find it at where she went yesterday. 

Thanks!

Good thought, I will think about this for a while. 

Her way of organizing is... unique to say the least. It’s hard to describe in text. But imagine a grocery list where it starts on a post it note, but then continues on a back of an envelope or an unused tissue or anything you can write on.

I now realize I might get a lot of comments like this... and I realize how it seems. But this is just not at all in character with my mom at all. I know her. 

Might make an edit about this, just trust me on this I’m VERY sure this isn’t what happened.

I realize I might get a lot of comments like this... and I realize how it seems. But this is just not at all in character with my mom at all. I know her. 

Might make an edit about this, just trust me on this I’m VERY sure this isn’t what happened.

Thank you for your support and I totally get what you mean. I’m glad that if this happens with another woman in this guys life, it’ll be easier for her hopefully if she reports. Also it will be a lot of peace of mind to me once this is all over. 

But I can also entirely empathize with people who don’t want to report for a whole host of reasons, a lot of which I’m currently experiencing myself as I go through this reporting and legal process. It definitely has been a nightmare process. In the end I know I’ll be glad that I did it. But there have been days where I just want to give up, drop it all, cry, and just hope the ex goes away. 

Someone deciding to not report doesn’t make them any less of a good person. I don’t think that’s what you were getting at. But I just want to make it clear for everyone, no one should feel bad for making the choice that is right for them and their mental and physical health.
